gaps.spec_claim:
- Returns the class-qualified function identifier obtained by removing the
    path prefix up to and including the source-file component from fqn
  - A component is recognized as a source-file component when it consists of
    a non-empty base name, a hyphen, and a suffix that is a recognized
    source-file language extension
  - When fqn contains more than one source-file component, the rightmost one
    determines where the prefix ends
  - When fqn contains no source-file component, returns the last component
    of fqn unchanged
  - The returned string is non-empty
gaps.actual_behavior: Let parts = fqn.split("::"), n = len(parts). Let i be the largest index in the range [0, n-1] such that there exists an integer pos > 0 where parts[i][pos] == '-' and parts[i][pos+1:] is a key in EXT_TO_LANG. If such an i exists, then result = "::".join(parts[i+1:]) (which may be an empty string if i == n-1). Otherwise, result = parts[-1].
gaps.trigger_condition: When the rightmost source-file component is the last component of the FQN, parts[i+1:] is empty, so the code returns an empty string, violating the specification requirement that the returned string is non-empty.
